dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 14, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Suzuki Slams Cubs Past Cardinals, Padres Outlast Guardians**

Seiya Suzuki delivered a huge blow to the St. Louis Cardinals, homering for the 21st time this season as the Chicago Cubs cruised to a 3-0 victory. Suzuki's three-RBI blast helped Chicago extend its winning streak to three games. On the mound, Clay Holmes earned the win for the Cubs, while Matthew Liberatore took the loss for the Cardinals.

In other action, Chase Burns threw a gem for the Cincinnati Reds, striking out eight over seven scoreless innings to lead the Reds to a 1-0 win over the Miami Marlins. Eugenio Suárez was the lone bright spot for Miami, doubling in the Reds' only run.

The Pittsburgh Pirates picked up a crucial win against the Boston Red Sox, with Rafael Flores Jr. hitting a home run and driving in two runs to lead the charge. Bubba Chandler earned the win for the Pirates, while Jake Bennett took the loss for the Red Sox.

Miguel Vargas continued to rake for the Chicago White Sox, hitting two home runs and driving in three runs to lead the White Sox to a 9-5 win over the Detroit Tigers. Vargas now has 27 home runs on the season.

In a tight game, the Baltimore Orioles edged the Tampa Bay Rays 6-5, with Gunnar Henderson hitting a home run and driving in two runs to lead the Orioles. Josh Walker earned the win for the Orioles, while Garrett Cleavinger took the loss for the Rays.

The Arizona Diamondbacks picked up a shutout win over the Atlanta Braves, with Chris Sale striking out nine over six scoreless innings to lead the Diamondbacks. Tim Tawa hit a home run for the Diamondbacks, while Brandon Pfaadt earned the win.

The Houston Astros came from behind to beat the Seattle Mariners 10-7, with Christian Walker hitting a home run and driving in three runs to lead the Astros. Peter Lambert earned a no-decision for the Mariners, while Enyel De Los Santos earned the win for the Astros.
